classGuide.investor-impacting-outage: An investor-critical property is confirmed down or failing its authoritative critical path. Page immediately.
classGuide.outage: A non-investor-critical property is confirmed unavailable. Ordinary incident.
classGuide.degradation: Reachable but slow, intermittent, or failing a non-critical check.
classGuide.maintenance: Routine platform hygiene: expiring certificates, parked zones needing a topology decision, contract drift.
classGuide.observability-gap: We cannot see the property well enough to know its state (no live instrumentation, single probe vantage).
classGuide.stale-evidence: Evidence exists but has aged past its freshness policy; automation may be failing.
classGuide.insufficient-evidence: The probe could not establish state (blocked/challenged, no contract). Not an outage.
classGuide.measurement-claim-block: An investor-facing claim cannot be made until the measurement is certified.
classGuide.business-opportunity: Upside that needs evidence before it is claimed.
classGuide.narrative-provenance: External or public narrative is inconsistent with the product.

priorityModel.summary: Score = severity + investor-critical + strategic tier + business impact + escalation + actionability + confidence + age. Higher is more urgent. Every item publishes the exact points behind its score.
priorityModel.tieBreak: Equal scores are ordered by item id, so ranking is deterministic.

derivation.note: Items with source "derived" are computed from probe, history, inventory, audience and business-event evidence on every collection run; source "manual" items are hand-authored judgments with no derivable evidence.

actionability.blockedBy: A human-audience source with bot/agent classification (GA4 Data API or first-party browser telemetry with verified reception)

items.title: Certify human audience metrics
items.observed: The latest measured operational edge snapshot (2026-09-23.2) contains 36,391 raw visits, including 31,681 attached to a synthetic health path. Mission Control probes add tagged synthetic traffic that must also be excluded.
items.businessReason: Operational edge telemetry cannot responsibly stand in for human traction. Investors will ask how many real people use this.
items.nextAction: Connect certified GA4/RUM-quality audience ingestion (history ingestion seam: certified-audience) with explicit bot, monitor, API, asset, and Mission Control probe exclusions.

escalation.escalateWhen: Any investor material attempts to present raw edge visits or requests as human audience before certification.

items.observed: The authoritative critical-path contract (owner-source-route) failed: search-api (status-500). The homepage may look fine while the function users depend on is broken.
items.businessReason: The homepage may respond while the product function investors and users depend on is broken.
items.nextAction: Inspect the failing check(s) against production and the latest deploy; fix the route or correct the contract if the product intentionally changed.

items.title: 0 of 20 properties report business outcomes
items.observed: Event-producing routes exist in source for aiaimate.com (signup, purchase); cyancanoe.com (lead); goodflippindesign.com (lead, purchase), but no governed feed connects them. The rest declare no countable outcome.
items.businessReason: Traffic without outcomes cannot show that the estate produces value: leads, sign-ups, purchases and downloads are what an investor asks about after audience.
items.nextAction: Start with the properties whose producers already exist in source: publish counts to the globaldeets-business-events-feed contract (per property, event type and window) and set the events feed secrets.

escalation.escalateWhen: Any investor material states conversion or outcome figures.

items.title: Quantify Culture Sherpa convergence opportunity
items.observed: Culture Sherpa remains prominent in the estate and conceptually aligned with GlobalDeets place context, but shared usage evidence is not yet connected.
items.businessReason: The integration thesis could improve differentiation and depth, but should be supported by actual overlap and utility evidence.
items.nextAction: Measure cross-navigation, overlap, unique utility, search demand, and content reuse before making convergence claims.

escalation.escalateWhen: Integration is presented as realized value before shared usage evidence exists.

items.title: Accumulate enough comparable history for 7/28/90-day trends
items.observed: 1 scheduled daily snapshot retained (1/90 days of a full 90-day view); 1 measured operational-traffic snapshot; certified audience history: none.
items.businessReason: Trend charts become decision-grade only when they contain comparable observations rather than decorative lines.
items.nextAction: Scheduled collection accumulates snapshots automatically; connect the governed audience source to add comparable traffic points.

escalation.escalateWhen: A chart attempts to calculate a trend from fewer than two comparable measured observations.

items.title: 12 of 20 properties have no declared primary outcome
items.observed: 6 properties declare what a successful visit is; 12 do not, so nothing about them can be measured against an intent.
items.businessReason: A property with no declared outcome cannot be judged useful, whatever its traffic.
items.nextAction: Owners declare one primary outcome per property from the common vocabulary (visit, engagement, CTA, lead, sign-up, application, purchase, download, or another declared outcome).

escalation.escalateWhen: A property is presented to investors as revenue-generating.

items.title: 16 of 20 serving properties still need an owner-declared critical path
items.observed: 4 of 20 serving properties have an authoritative critical-path contract (globaldeets.com, aiaimate.com, goodflippindesign.com, minnesotapeace.com); the rest are checked only against a homepage identity baseline, which cannot prove the product works.
items.businessReason: Reachable-unverified is not verified health; only owned, contracted paths can prove the product works.
items.nextAction: Each property owner names the one route or function that proves the product works (API endpoint, key page, search) and Mission Control adds it to the registry.

escalation.escalateWhen: A property is described to investors as production-grade without an authoritative contract.

items.title: 4 domains publish nothing and their intent is not declared
items.observed: artificelligance.com, artificelligence.com, fwomps.com, fwomp.us resolve without address records and no service or intent is declared. This is not an outage.
items.businessReason: Owned domains that publish nothing waste brand surface, and without a declared intent no one can tell a deliberate reservation from an abandoned project.
items.nextAction: Decide per domain: reserve it (record it as intentionally unpublished), publish a placeholder, redirect to a primary property, or release it.

escalation.escalateWhen: A parked domain is referenced in investor or public material as an active property.

items.title: 5 properties have no owner-declared lifecycle
items.observed: The owner has not declared whether agentkagent.com, cyancanoe.com, flipskillet.com, foxyana.com, goodflippinyikes.com are active, incubating, dormant or deprecated. Mission Control shows what production does and leaves the intent unknown.
items.businessReason: Without a declared lifecycle an expected pause looks the same as neglect, and real outages cannot be told from intended silence.
items.nextAction: Owners declare each property's lifecycle and purpose in the estate registry.

escalation.escalateWhen: A property is described to investors without a declared lifecycle.

items.title: 7 Pages projects with no custom domain
items.observed: community-health-intelligence, communityhealth, culturesherpa, foxyana, goodflippinvibes, saintpaul-portal, weaver exist on Cloudflare Pages with no custom domain mapped, so they serve no governed property. They may still answer on a pages.dev address that is not monitored.
items.businessReason: Deployed projects nobody reaches through a governed domain consume the platform without observable use, and their pages.dev addresses stay public and unmonitored.
items.nextAction: For each project decide: map a domain, archive, or delete.
